_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: A  blog  page as markdown
operations.description: The markdown twin of a page under `/blog/`: YAML frontmatter with `title` and `description`, then an H1 and the body. Equivalent to requesting `/blog/{slug}` with `Accept: text/markdown`. The slugs that exist are listed in `/blog/llms.txt`.

operations.name: A  case studies  page as markdown
operations.description: The markdown twin of a page under `/case-studies/`: YAML frontmatter with `title` and `description`, then an H1 and the body. Equivalent to requesting `/case-studies/{slug}` with `Accept: text/markdown`. The slugs that exist are listed in `/case-studies/llms.txt`.

operations.name: Echo the caller's ip
operations.description: Returns the IP address the CDN saw for this request. `null` when the edge did not supply one.

operations.name: Check a faucet transaction
operations.description: Checks a transaction returned by `sendFaucetFunds`. Unconfirmed transfers report `status: "pending"`. For Solana, the signature must belong to a stored faucet transaction; unknown signatures return HTTP `404`. Failed or expired transfers report `status: "failed"`.

faucetId.description: Network the transaction was submitted to.

transactionHash.description: EVM transaction hash or Solana transaction signature.

operations.name: Homepage as markdown
operations.description: The homepage rendered as markdown: what Alchemy is, the products and chains it supports, and who builds on it. Equivalent to requesting `/` with `Accept: text/markdown`.

operations.name: Whole site in one file
operations.description: Every page body concatenated into a single file. Large; prefer `/llms.txt` plus per-page `.md` fetches unless you genuinely want everything.

operations.name: Curated site index
operations.description: Every page on the site, grouped by section, one line each with a title, URL and one-sentence description. Long sections are split into `//llms.txt` files linked from here. Follows the llmstxt.org convention.

operations.name: This document
operations.description: The OpenAPI description of this API. Also served at `/api/openapi.json`.

operations.name: Site search index
operations.description: The full command-palette index for a locale: blog posts, guides, case studies and dapp listings, each with a title, description and URL. Prebuilt at deploy time and served from the CDN, so it is cheap to fetch whole and filter client-side. For a text index of the same content, prefer `/llms.txt`.

locale.description: Content locale. The index is prerendered per locale, so only the listed values are served; anything else is a 404, not a fallback to English.

operations.name: Sitemap
operations.description: Every indexable URL, as a standard XML sitemap index.

operations.name: A  terms conditions  page as markdown
operations.description: The markdown twin of a page under `/terms-conditions/`: YAML frontmatter with `title` and `description`, then an H1 and the body. Equivalent to requesting `/terms-conditions/{slug}` with `Accept: text/markdown`. The slugs that exist are listed in `/llms-full.txt`.

operations.name: Any  api path that does not exist
operations.description: Not an endpoint. Listed so the failure shape is discoverable: every request under `/api/` that matches no operation above answers `404` with an `Error` body rather than an HTML page, for any method. Read `error.code` to branch and `error.hint` for the next step.

unmatchedPath.description: Any path under `/api/` with no operation.
